facts.text: The booklet's Independent evidence label covers peer-reviewed studies, standard or regulation texts, official statistics, third-party tests, and government or agency reports.
facts.quote: **Independent** (peer-reviewed study, standard or regulation text, official statistics, third-party test, government or agency report)

facts.text: The booklet's Vendor evidence label identifies a supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper.
facts.quote: **Vendor** (a supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper)

facts.text: The booklet's Expert opinion evidence label identifies a practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without data.
facts.quote: **Expert opinion** (practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without data)

facts.text: The booklet's “(on-road evidence)” marker identifies findings proven only for road vehicles.
facts.quote: Findings proven only for road vehicles carry the marker **(on-road evidence)**

facts.text: Standards that had not been issued by October 2026 are marked “(draft)”, “(under publication)” or “(under revision)” in the booklet.
facts.quote: standards that had not been issued by October 2026 carry **(draft)**, **(under publication)** or **(under revision)**
